original_sql:
SELECT p.payment_id, p.customer_id, p.amount
FROM payment p
WHERE p.amount > (SELECT AVG(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.customer_id = p.customer_id)

candidates.sql: SELECT p.payment_id, p.customer_id, p.amount FROM payment p JOIN (SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) sub ON p.customer_id = sub.customer_id WHERE p.amount > sub.avg_amount
candidates.rationale: Rewrites the correlated subquery into a join with a subquery that calculates the average amount per customer, which can be more efficient due to reduced row scanning.
